item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pas pho nya rta yi lo'i zla tshes la nub phyogs/ kong yul dga' ba'i tshal gyi dbus phyogs yongs rdzong dpal gyi phug nas/ bcas te rol mo sgra yis bsus nas spyan drangs shing / khyung nag rdzong gi rtse ru shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o// rigs mthun grogs kyi gtsos te nye gnas dgu pa'i spyod yul dang po las su rtsom ste dang slar don grub pa sa lug lo la gyim shod shel brag gi dben gnas/

item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i bsgrub (sgrub) pa las 'chi med bdun rtsi sman gyi bsgrub thabs
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pas pho nya sa rta lo'i zla tshes la nub phyogs kong yul dga' ba'i tshal gyi dbus gyur yang rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas rigs mthun grogs kyis brtsal (rtsal) te nye gnas dgu yi spyod yul dngos su chas te/ rol mo'i sgra'i (sgras) bsus te spyan drangs shing slar don 'grub ces pas lug lo la gyim shod shel brag tshal gyi dben gnas khyung nag rdzong gis rtse ru shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
